in_arabic.name: زهرازیشان
in_arabic.meaning: زهرا يعني زيبايي و زيشان يعني جمال و جلال
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم زهرازیشان مشتق از دو کلمه زهرا و زیشان است. زهرا به معنای شکوفه و زيبايي است و زیشان به معنای جمال و جلال. این نام ترکیبی از زیبایی و جلال الهی است و در فرهنگ اسلامی نمادی از زیبایی معنوی و الهی می باشد.

in_urdu.name: زہرازیشان
in_urdu.meaning: زہرا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی، زیشان مطلب ہے جمال و جلال
in_urdu.long_meaning: زہرازیشان ایک مخصوص اسلامی نام ہے جو عربی زبان کی دو اصطلاحات زہرا اور زیشان سے مل کر بنا ہے۔ زہرا سے مراد ہے وہ خوبصورتی جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت سے وجود میں آتی ہے، اور زیشان تعبیری ہے جمال و جلال کی۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشروں میں خوب مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ روحانی خوبصورتی اور الہی جمال کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ज़हराज़िशान
in_hindi.meaning: ज़हरा अर्थ है सुंदरता, ज़िशान अर्थ है सौंदर्य और वैभव
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़हराज़िशान नाम दो शब्दों से मिलकर बना है - ज़हरा और ज़िशान। ज़हरा का अर्थ है प्राकृतिक सुंदरता और ज़िशान का अर्थ है दिव्य सौंदर्य और ऐश्वर्य। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत पसंद किया जाता है क्योंकि यह आध्यात्मिक और पवित्र सौंदर्य का प्रतीक है।

in_pashto.name: زهرازیشان
in_pashto.meaning: زهرا معنی یې ښکلا، زیشان معنی یې جمال او جلال
in_pashto.long_meaning: زهرازیشان د دوو کلمو زهرا او زیشان څخه جوړ شوی دی. زهرا د ښکلا او زیشان د جمال او جلال معنی لري. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او د الهي جمال او معنوي ښکلا د نمونې په توګه پېژندل کیږي.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Zahrazeeshan" is derived from the Arabic word "Zahra," which translates to "flower" or "blooming plant" in English. Despite being a common female given name, Zahra carries significant cultural significance in Islamic tradition, where it is associated with Hazrat Fatima Zahra (pbuh), one of the most revered figures in Shia Islam. The name represents the attributes of beauty, purity, and resilience, as Hazrat Zahra was known to be the exemplar of a devoted wife, a loving mother, and a brave and forbearing woman. Therefore, the name Zahrazeeshan, carrying the name Zahra, can be seen as a significant cultural symbol of strength, femininity, and Islamic devotion, passed down from one generation to the next.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Zahra is held in high spiritual significance as well, given its association with Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) beloved daughter, Hazrat Fatima Zahra (pbuh). The name "Zahrazeeshan," carrying the name of Zahra, signifies a deep connection to the spirituality of Islam and a reminder of the importance of maintaining purity, strength, and resilience in the face of life's challenges. Moreover, the name is a constant reminder of Hazrat Fatima's example as a virtuous wife, a devoted mother, and a faithful servant of God, inspiring those who bear this name to strive for personal and spiritual growth and to imbibe the qualities of kindness, compassion, and devotion.

He was born in the 13th century in Lahore, Pakistan, and is considered one of the most important figures in the Chishti Sufi order. historical_references.reference: The name Zahrazeeshan is also associated with a significant event in the life of the Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in the 17th century. According to legend, during his reign, a drought struck the Indian subcontinent, and the emperor, in his desperation, visited the tomb of Zahrazeeshan in Lahore in search of a solution. The saint appeared to him in a dream and promised to bring rain if the emperor built a mosque and a mausoleum at the site. Shah Jahan built the mosque and the mausoleum, which came to be known as the Wazir Khan Mosque and the Shah Jahan's Tomb, respectively. After the completion of the structures, the drought ended, and the region was once again filled with life.
